name: Paper Fangs: A Queer Appalachian Tale
source:
Will you embrace yourself as a true creature of the night? Or keep yourself tied to this mortal coil with its paper fangs?

In Paper Fangs VN, you play as a trans man in the middle of Appalachia who finds himself in a listless wasteland until he meets an unusual stranger at an empty waffle house late at night.

[From [url=https://mvessick.itch.io/paper-fangs]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你愿意拥抱自己作为真正的夜晚生物吗？还是把自己绑在这个用纸尖牙缠绕的凡人线圈上？

在《Paper Fangs VN》中，你扮演一名阿巴拉契亚中部的跨性别者，他发现自己身处一片无精打采的荒原，直到深夜在一家空荡荡的华夫饼屋里遇到了一个不寻常的陌生人。

[来自[url=https://mvessick.itch.io/paper-fangs]Itch.io[/url]]
